blocks.html: Where the weight of lay-in ceiling panels, used as part of fire-resistance-rated floor/ceiling or roof/ceiling assemblies, is not adequate to resist an upward force of 1 pound per square foot (47.8 Pa), wire or other approved devices shall be installed above the panels to prevent vertical displacement under such upward force.
